LESSON: SIGN READING 6.2.4 PICTURE READING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Sign Reading 6.2.4 Picture reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 6.2.4 Picture reading, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do you read pictures from a chart? 2. What are some of the things found within our school? 2. Which things within the school do you like most?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 6.2.4 Picture reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Respect: Etiquette as learner walks calmly alongside others during the nature walk.

● Peace: Love as learner walks with peers within the school compound during nature walk without causing conflicts and focusing

on identification of objects whose pictures were seen.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
81

Child Safety and security as learner is guided on how to ensure safety during the nature walk within the school.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Linked to all learning areas as learners read pictures of different things

Suggested Learning Resources:

interactive technology, such as educational apps or games designed for picture reading, flashcards, posters, charts, interactive games

that focus on picture reading, picture cutouts, picture puzzles.
